ios.desc:
Welcome to LifeArk, an online sanctuary for the things and people who matter. Designed to help families share memories, wisdom and family history, LifeArk is the first family-focused social media platform connecting past and future generations. Our mission is to help families cultivate stronger, more meaningful and lasting relationships in a rapidly evolving world where privacy, the family institute and family values are under threat. 

• Invite members of your family to join your family space. 
• Capture and share meaningful memories, milestones, family history and life lessons so your kids grow up ready to take on the world with a sense of family and self. 
• Posts are categorised as memories or pieces of wisdom, then visualised in a dated timeline on your profile. Your timeline expands as you add more content and tags to your posts. 
• Create profiles of your children and grandchildren to access in the future or digital memorials of loved ones who have passed away. 
• Answer inspiring questions curated by family psychologists to create an authentic portrait of who you are, what you value, what you’ve learned and want to share with the ones who matter most. 
• Send questions you'd like to get answered in order to get to know your family better. 

Benefits:
• Be your child's first and most important influencer. 
• Give your children a foundation of values, principles and life experience from which they can grow. 
• Help your children understand you better. 
• Assure your family's stories, history and life lessons don't get lost in the clutter of the cloud and social media. 
• Build a meaningful and lasting relationship with your child from day one. 
• Strong family bonds and knowing family history are the most important indicators of early childhood success.

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I'm Daniel, the founder of LifeArk (https://www.lifeark.io)

LifeArk is a family time capsule designed to help parents share love and life experience.

Combining the best features of email, social media and narrative journaling, LifeArk helps share family history, interests and life lessons with children, friends or relatives in the future.

I came up with the idea of creating a digital time capsule for my son when becoming a dad...I looked at the parenting app market and saw there was no product or online solution helping parents save all the things they want to share with their kids in the future.

Our memories and “digital DNA” are fragmented, with images of ourselves scattered between email, social media, text message and the cloud. We share intimate details of our lives with distant friends, politicians, advertisers and strangers on public commercial platforms, but have no way to organize and share what matters most with our kids.

What if we used technology to focus our attention on the people that matter? What if there was a way families to navigate the digital realm?

Now there is.

How it works:
LifeArk is available for download in the AppStore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/generation-transfer/id1295727305
